behavior.power: Full configured amount applies to PVE and PVP while equipped through the existing one-title loadout.
behavior.counting: Distinct COMPLETED ranked-season settlements with a completion timestamp, recorded tier_id=challenger and final_rank 1..20. Nonconsecutive seasons count. No reinterpretation of historical non-Challenger results.
behavior.award: Existing authenticated character/title/sync, scheduled by the production title screen; one permanent ownership row; CMS policy and history checked again at insertion.
behavior.supporter: Manual CMS grant only. No recipients or account grants inferred.
behavior.cms: Both records retain later CMS edits; power/style/visibility/condition available through the existing title manager.
behavior.animation: Supporter logo aura and perimeter sparkle CSS loops, static reduced-motion fallback; a 36-frame 5.4-second GIF export is also included.

release.reason: Two title catalogue entries, their existing title-sync qualification and shared title appearance only. Existing tables and transaction adapter; no schema, dependency, authentication, battle engine or common transaction changes.
